title: Milestone window never re-anchored after an advance — the gate chain-fires era N+1 one tick later, measured on the predecessor era's window
evidence:
core/era.odin era_step fire tail (no era_gate re-baseline):
	new_era := state.era_advance_to
	state.era = new_era
	state.era_advance_to = 0
	event_emit_era(state, tick, new_era)

core/era.odin:188 (era_gate_sla_ok — global tick, not era-relative):
	if state.tick < u64(cat.balance.advance.milestone_window_ticks) {
		return false
	}

core/era.odin:183-186 comment: "// means the window itself traversed). The window is anchored at the era's // start (the run's setup era = tick 0 for the MVP single advance; the ring // rolls continuously)."

data/eras.json rows 1 and 2 (identical gate inputs): "packet_types": ["email"] and "pipe_tiers": ["narrow", "standard"]
detail: Fire path never re-baselines era_gate; elapsed check uses global tick. A gate-on run starting era 1 fires 1→2 at tick 600, then 2→3 at 601 — era 2's milestone is 599/600 era-1 traffic (eras 1-2 share roster + tiers).
recommended_fix: On fire, re-baseline the gate for the new era: clear ring/win sums (or latch era_start_tick and require tick − era_start ≥ window) so each era sustains its own milestone window.

title: overlay_check's Demo_Replay literal omits advance_gate_on — overlay re-sims the 3 new gate demos gate-OFF
evidence:
harness/overlay.odin:46-52:
	cfg := Demo_Replay{
		name = d.name,
		use_fixture = d.use_fixture,
		qos_fixture = d.qos_fixture,
		session = {goal = d.win_goal, cap_ms = d.lose_cap_ms, health_on = d.health_on, surge_win_pct = d.surge_win_pct},
	}

harness/run.odin:643 (the flag demo_apply_setup reads, absent above):
	state.advance_gate_enabled = cfg.advance_gate_on // 6.2: run setup — re-created identically on every replay
detail: B1's class in a residual site: PP_DEBUG `overlay-check advance_fire <ms>` re-sims gate-off — post-tick-600 frames silently render era 2, wrong demand plan and no streaming unlock. growth_on is also absent (pre-existing).
recommended_fix: Add `advance_gate_on = d.advance_gate_on` (and the missing `growth_on = d.growth_on`) to overlay.odin's Demo_Replay literal so the overlay re-creates the full run setup.

title: New `advance` balance block parses via jint — a decimal value silently truncates instead of fail-fast
detail: A decimal milestone_window_ticks (e.g. 600.5) truncates to 600 and loads silently. The era loader rejects decimals via jint_strict (demand_era row); the new advance block has no decimal rejection row.
recommended_fix: Parse the advance keys with jint_strict (reject json.Float) like eras.json's demand_era, and add a decimal negative row to the advance fail-fast test table.
